name: odk-readiness-submission
title: ODK readiness assessment submission (CSV)
description: One row per answered question, per country, per assessment period. Files go in data/submissions/<hazard>/. Extra columns, such as the full ODK export columns, are allowed and ignored.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: Country name as in ODK. Must match a name or alias in data/config/countries.json (case-insensitive).

fields.name: AdminLevel
fields.description: Only 'National' rows are scored at present. Defaults to National if blank.

fields.name: DataPeriod
fields.description: Assessment round: YYYY or YYYY-Qn, e.g. 2026-Q4.

fields.name: QuestionKey
fields.description: Stable ODK question name. Must exist in data/questions/<hazard>.csv.

fields.name: NationalYN
fields.description: Answer. A blank answer is scored as not met and reported as a warning.
